subject: Brightline - wire transfers only going forward
text:
Hi there,

Due to repeated ACH delays on our side, Brightline Office Supply is moving to wire transfers only for all customer payments, effective immediately. Please send wires to our wire receiving account below, which is different from the ACH account you have on file:

Beneficiary: Brightline Office Supply Inc
Beneficiary bank: Truist Bank
ABA: 061000104
Account: 2034418871
SWIFT: BRBTUS33

Please confirm once your records are updated. Open invoices 55120, 55187 and 55203 can be wired together.

Best,
Carla Benson
Credit & Collections
